selection.rule: highest pooled LOAO endpoint-param macro-F1 (all training apps), fixed before DSVW is collected or scored
selection.feature_set_frozen_at: iteration 2 (raw_reflected_dangerous); no feature changes after the final collection

freeze.ground_truth_hash_covers: json.dumps({app, endpoints, skip, passive} for dsvw, sort_keys=True)
freeze.rule: DSVW is labelled from source only, never collected for training or tuning; collected and scored exactly once by scripts/eval_final_v2.py after the v2 model is fixed by SHA-256

metric: ML: endpoint-param macro-F1 over classes present, per-class P/R/F1, cluster bootstrap 1000; rules/passive: counts
